item.name: Register
item.description: Creates a new account using email and password. The account is created with the CUSTOMER role by default.

item.name: Login
item.description: Authenticates a user using email and password and returns access and refresh tokens for authenticated API access.

item.name: Refresh Access Token
item.description: Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token.

item.name: Get Current User
item.description: Returns the profile and role information of the currently authenticated user.

item.name: Google Login
item.description: Initiates Google OAuth authentication and redirects the user to Google's authentication page.

item.name: Google OAuth Callback
item.description: Handles the callback from Google after successful OAuth authentication and creates or authenticates the corresponding user account.

item.name: Get My Profile
item.description: Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Update My Profile
item.description: Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Get My Addresses
item.description: Returns all active addresses belonging to the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Create Address
item.description: Creates a new service address for the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Get Address
item.description: Returns a specific address belonging to the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Update Address
item.description: Updates an existing address belonging to the currently authenticated customer.

item.name: Delete Address
item.description: Soft-deletes an address belonging to the currently authenticated customer so that it is no longer available for new service requests.

item.name: Get Services
item.description: Returns a paginated list of active services available for customers, with optional search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

item.name: Get Service
item.description: Returns the details of a specific service.

item.name: Create Service
item.description: Creates a new service that can be offered to customers. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Update Service
item.description: Updates the details of an existing service. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Delete Service
item.description: Soft-deletes a service so that it is no longer available for new service requests. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Create Service Request
item.description: Creates a new service request for the authenticated customer using a selected service and service address.

item.name: Get Service Request
item.description: Returns the details of a specific service request. Customers can access their own requests, while administrators can access any request.

item.name: Get My Service Requests
item.description: Returns a paginated list of service requests created by the authenticated customer, with optional status, priority, sorting, and pagination filters.

item.name: Get All Service Requests
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all service requests for administrators, with optional status, priority, sorting, and pagination filters.

item.name: Update Service Request
item.description: Updates an editable service request belonging to the authenticated customer. Only requests that are still eligible for modification can be updated.

item.name: Update Service Request Status
item.description: Updates the status of a service request according to the allowed service-request status transitions. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Cancel Service Request
item.description: Cancels a service request belonging to the authenticated customer when its current status allows cancellation.

item.name: Create Work Order
item.description: Converts an approved service request into a work order and creates the initial work-order status history. The service price is captured as a price snapshot for the work order.

item.name: Get Work Order
item.description: Returns detailed information about a work order, including its service, customer, address, assignments, status history, notes, and invoice when available.

item.name: Get All Work Orders
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all work orders for administrators, with optional status filtering, sorting, and pagination.

item.name: Update Work Order
item.description: Updates editable information of a work order. This endpoint is restricted to administrators and does not allow modification of completed or cancelled work orders.

item.name: Update Work Order Status
item.description: Updates the status of a work order according to the allowed workflow transitions. Technicians can update operational statuses for their assigned work orders, while administrators can manage administrative status changes.

item.name: Get My Work Orders
item.description: Returns a paginated list of work orders belonging to the authenticated customer.

item.name: Schedule Work Order
item.description: Assigns a scheduled start and end time to a work order and updates its status to SCHEDULED. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Get My Work Orders
item.description: Returns a paginated list of work orders currently assigned to the authenticated technician.

item.name: Get Admin Dashboard
item.description: Returns administrative dashboard statistics and operational metrics for monitoring users, service requests, work orders, invoices, and payments.

item.name: Get All Users
item.description: Returns a list of users for administrative management, including their roles and account status.

item.name: Update User Status
item.description: Activates or deactivates a user account. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

item.name: Get All Technicians
item.description: Returns a list of technicians for administrative management, including their profiles and account status.

item.name: Get All Payments
item.description: Returns a list of payment records for administrative monitoring and management.

item.name: Update User Role
item.description: Updates the role of an existing user. This endpoint is restricted to administrators and allows changing a user between the CUSTOMER and TECHNICIAN roles.

item.name: Create Payment
item.description: Initiates a payment for a payable invoice through the configured bKash payment gateway and returns the payment information required to continue the payment process.

item.name: bKash Payment Callback
item.description: Handles the callback returned by bKash after the customer completes, cancels, or fails a payment and verifies the payment result before updating the payment and invoice status.

item.name: Create Invoice
item.description: Creates an invoice for a completed work order. The invoice amount is calculated from the work-order service price and applicable tax rather than being determined by an arbitrary client-supplied total.

item.name: Get Invoice
item.description: Returns detailed information about a specific invoice, including its associated work order and payment records. Customers can access only their own invoices, while administrators can access any invoice.

item.name: Get All Invoices
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all invoices for administrators, with optional status filtering, sorting, and pagination.

item.name: Get My Invoices
item.description: Returns a paginated list of invoices belonging to the authenticated customer's work orders.

item.name: Update Invoice
item.description: Updates an existing invoice. This endpoint is restricted to administrators and allows authorized invoice details to be modified according to the current invoice status and business rules.

item.name: Get My Notifications
item.description: Returns the notifications belonging to the currently authenticated user.

item.name: Mark All Notifications as Read
item.description: Marks all unread notifications belonging to the authenticated user as read.

item.name: Create Notification
item.description: Creates a notification for a user. This endpoint is restricted to administrators and allows them to send system notifications related to service requests, work orders, assignments, schedules, invoices, payments, or other system events.

item.name: Mark Notification as Read
item.description: Marks a specific notification belonging to the authenticated user as read.

item.name: Get Work Order Notes
item.description: Returns the notes associated with a specific work order that the authenticated user is authorized to access.

item.name: Create Work Order Note
item.description: Adds a new note to a work order for authorized users involved in the work order.

item.name: Update Work Order Note
item.description: Updates an existing work-order note when the authenticated user is authorized to modify it.

item.name: Delete Work Order Note
item.description: Soft-deletes an existing work-order note so that it is no longer displayed as an active note.

item.name: Get Work Order Assignments
item.description: Returns the technician assignments associated with a specific work order.

item.name: Assign Technician
item.description: Assigns a technician to a work order and updates the work-order assignment state accordingly.

item.name: Remove Technician Assignment
item.description: Removes an active technician assignment from a work order.

item.name: Create Availability
item.description: Creates an availability time period for the currently authenticated technician.

item.name: Get My Availability
item.description: Returns the availability schedules configured by the currently authenticated technician.

item.name: Update Availability
item.description: Updates an existing availability period belonging to the authenticated technician.

item.name: Delete Availability
item.description: Removes an availability period belonging to the authenticated technician.

item.name: Get Technician
item.description: Returns the profile information of a specific technician.

item.name: Get My Technician Profile
item.description: Returns the technician profile associated with the currently authenticated technician account.

item.name: Update My Technician Profile
item.description: Updates editable profile information of the currently authenticated technician.

item.name: Get Technicians
item.description: Returns a list of active technicians available in the system.

item.name: Update Technician Profile Status
item.description: Updates the active status of a technician. This endpoint is restricted to administrators and allows an administrator to activate or deactivate a technician.
